absorption: Upstream ships an equivalent deployable HTTP/OAuth MCP whose security, identity, transport, persistence, and proxy contracts pass the fork's focused/integration proof.

consumers.name: The public ChatGPT-facing Honcho MCP deployment.

contract: The Node MCP deployment exposes persistent proxy-aware Streamable HTTP with owner-password OAuth, DCR bounded to 500 retained client registrations, PKCE, exact redirect validation, refresh/revocation, hashed token persistence, server-side Honcho authorization, and rejection of unsupported standalone SSE streams.

fork: cd mcp && bun run typecheck:node && bun test`.
proof.fork_expected: Node typecheck/tests pass, standalone SSE is rejected, dynamic registration rejects client 501 without losing the first 500 registrations, and authorized integration proof survives OAuth token refresh/restart behind the configured proxy.
upstream: inspect the Node MCP transport/auth/deployment surface on the recorded upstream base.
proof.upstream_expected: the persistent HTTP/OAuth deployment and its security/transport contract are absent.

replay: Preserve one-hop proxy trust, public HTTPS metadata, registration hostname allowlisting, exact registered redirect equality, token hashing, and server-side Honcho authorization.
upstream_gap: The recorded upstream base does not provide this Node HTTP/OAuth deployment, its proxy/public-URL security policy, persisted OAuth lifecycle, or transport tests.
